**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast tray with grilled tomato, avocado, mushroom, a pat of butter, and two slices of fruit or nut bread, plus a cup of coffee (the cup is not food on a plate, so it is excluded).

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The main plate is a side plate of about 20 cm diameter, area 314 cm². A second small plate of about 18 cm holds the bread, area 254 cm². Both are part of the meal, so I count them together.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Grilled tomato halves (2)
- Avocado slices
- Grilled mushroom
- Butter pat
- Fruit/nut bread slices (2, one toasted triangle and one plain)

**STEP 4 - Area (of the 314 cm² main plate, plus bread plate):**
- Tomato: 8% of main plate, about 25 cm²
- Avocado: 6%, about 19 cm²
- Mushroom: 4%, about 13 cm²
- Butter: 4%, about 13 cm²
- Bread: about 76 cm² of the bread plate, roughly 30% of it

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Tomato: 25 cm² × 1.5 cm = 38 ml
- Avocado: 19 cm² × 1.5 cm = 28 ml
- Mushroom: 13 cm² × 1.5 cm = 19 ml
- Butter: 13 cm² × 0.8 cm = 10 ml
- Bread: 76 cm² × 1.2 cm = 91 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Tomato: 38 ml × 0.6 = 23 g
- Avocado: 28 ml × 0.6 = 17 g
- Mushroom: 19 ml × 0.9 = 17 g
- Butter: 10 ml × 0.9 = 9 g
- Bread: 91 ml × 0.77 ≈ 70 g. I used a lower bulk density than the 0.9 to 1.0 guideline because bread slices are much lighter than a dense solid. Two toast slices of this size are realistically about 60 to 70 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Tomato: 23 g × 20 kcal/100 g ≈ 5 kcal
- Avocado: 17 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 27 kcal
- Mushroom: 17 g × 22 kcal/100 g ≈ 4 kcal
- Butter: 9 g × 717 kcal/100 g ≈ 65 kcal
- Bread: 70 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 182 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 136 g and 283 kcal. That is plausible for a light breakfast with two slices of bread and small portions of vegetables and butter. The plates are not heavily loaded, so this is not an excessive estimate.
